page_title: KyttoMCP — MCP Server Manager for macOS & Windows

summary.name: KyttoMCP
summary.one_liner: KyttoMCP is a free, open-source local app for macOS and Windows that manages MCP servers across Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex from one view.
keywords: see which ai clients use a server
use_cases: See which MCP servers are enabled in each AI client
Diagnose a failing MCP server connection
Switch MCP server sets between profiles such as Coding or Research
Back up and restore MCP config files before changes
Estimate how much context MCP tool definitions consume
Review MCP tool descriptions for hidden instructions or changes
summary.what_it_does:
KyttoMCP reads the existing JSON and TOML MCP configuration files for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex and shows where each server is enabled in one matrix. It lets you switch servers on or off, create or edit entries manually or from a built-in catalog, and save profiles that you preview before applying. Health checks run an on-demand MCP handshake and show tools, prompts, resources, stderr and estimated token weight, and MCP Doctor names likely causes of failures. Every write checks for external changes, creates a timestamped backup and writes atomically, and backups can be browsed and restored.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Open source under MIT License, with no account, cloud sync or telemetry on the current beta
Reads and writes each client's own config format rather than requiring a proprietary format or gateway
Tool-description and schema scan plus Contract Guard alerts when a server changes what it tells the model
Timestamped backups and guarded atomic writes before every change
caveats: Beta 1.0.9 builds are unsigned, so macOS and Windows show security warnings that must be bypassed manually
Linux is not supported in this release
Token-weight figures are estimates, not exact per-conversation usage
